page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per physical core.

This instance does not include local NVMe storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The lack of hyperthreading ensures that each of the 64 vCPUs maps directly to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention at the thread level but limiting concurrent thread execution compared to hyperthreaded alternatives.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory density of 8.0 GB per core positions this instance for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local disk I/O or GPU acceleration. The dedicated core allocation provides predictable compute performance. This hardware profile is suitable for in-memory databases, large-scale caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-bound data processing applications.
